Head of Product — Manager Enablement, London hybrid.

Peoplewise (300 people) builds HR-tech software for people-ops leaders — manager-enablement tools, 1:1 templates, and skip-level survey workflows, sold mostly through a hybrid outbound-and-inbound sales-assisted motion to mid-market and enterprise HR teams. We closed a large funding round this year and headcount has nearly doubled as we push into new segments. We're hiring a Head of Product to lead our four-person PM team, reporting to the CPO. Your remit also covers activating newly onboarded manager accounts — turning trial sign-ups into active weekly users — which pulls on the same activation-funnel muscle as more consumer-facing PLG products, even though our buyer is HR, not the end consumer. We do not offer equity as part of compensation, and we're not a household name yet. Hybrid: two days a week in our London office.
